answer: Proof of distinctness shows that two committed values are different without revealing either value, by proving their commitments do not open to the same content. A haven of separate commitments keeps each value hidden, a wander through the proof confirms the values diverge, and a pulse of verification checks the difference without exposing the data. A Sybil farm cannot clone one identity into many, because each pair of commitments must be shown distinct, and copying the same value across fake identities fails the proof immediately.
